_readme: Hand-maintained, committed, never written by a script. Work tools/geocode/report.csv (rows with status=review, sorted by confidence — easiest first) and add an entry per id you resolve. Applied last in 04-emit-seed.mjs, wins over everything. Two shapes: { "lat": 32.94, "lng": -96.73, "address": "...", "city": "...", "matchMethod": "manual" } to accept a corrected location, or { "drop": true, "reason": "..." } to explicitly exclude a row (e.g. confirmed permanently closed with no successor). Re-run `node tools/geocode/04-emit-seed.mjs` after editing this file — no need to re-run the geocoding phases.
